decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already records the $5-per-mint allocation to the remaining Small Block pool; the other Small Block rules remain valid.
The existing same-message MODIFY already removes both Big Block ticket-issuance attributes while preserving Small Block issuance.
The existing same-message MODIFY removes the Big Block prize copy and revises ticket, funding, delivery, allocation, and fiat-buyer copy to describe only the remaining Small Block prize.
The existing same-message MODIFY already removes the obsolete Big Block ticket counter and leaves the Small Block counter intact.
The existing same-message MODIFY already limits VRF winner selection and its scope to the remaining Small Block draw.
Removing the Big Block prize does not change the automatic direct-wallet delivery behavior for the remaining Small Block prize.
The source changes the prize structure and primary-mint revenue split, but does not change the enabled flat $10 secondary-sale royalty.
The existing same-message MODIFY already limits no-referral ticket allocation to the remaining Small Block draw.
The source explicitly retains the $5 affiliate share and does not change the referral commission trigger, recipient, timing, or payout behavior.
The existing same-message MODIFY already removes the obsolete Big Block ticket counter from NFT metadata.
The existing page update removes the Big Block draw elsewhere but retains no-referral copy saying each mint awards plural tickets; it must identify only one Small Block ticket.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey [FREELANCER_NAME_001], I’d like to remove the big blocks and redirect that extra $1 to me, making the split:
$15 buy, $5 to me, $5 to affiliate, $5 to block prize pool.

This improves my bottom line while having minimal effect on sales.
It also makes the game mechanics and marketing simpler.

An even split between me and every community member, together with everyone having an equal chance at the never-ending $500 prizes, seems consistent with the project’s ethos.

process_items.label: Mint the ebook NFT
process_items.copy: Buy your ebook NFT for $15 USD. The mint number you receive becomes your referral code.

process_items.label: Earn Through Referrals
process_items.copy: Share either your mint number or your link. Whenever someone mints with it, you immediately earn $5 USD. There are no limits and no expiration. If no code is provided → the $5 commission and one Small Block ticket are awarded to a random existing ticket holder.

process_items.label: Build Up Tickets
process_items.copy: Every referral also awards you Small Block prize tickets for the current block. More referrals = more tickets = greater chances.

process_items.label: Enter the Prize Draws
process_items.copy: The remaining Small Block awards never-ending $500 prizes. Chainlink VRF selects the winners randomly and fairly.

process_items.label: Receive Your Rewards
process_items.copy: Commissions are delivered automatically on-chain. Prize winners are announced on the Winners page, notified through dashboard and email, and receive the prize directly in their wallet.

decisions.reason: The Winners page, dashboard, and email notification channels remain valid for winners of the remaining Small Block prize.
